title: available field always true (dead weight)
impact: constant value; consumers cannot use it to distinguish state; only key-presence assertions
recommendation: keep for packet-shape stability; remove when discovery-context.test.ts coordinated

title: BUILTIN_CAPABILITIES shallow freeze — descriptor objects mutable via gate re-export
impact: in-process consumer could mutate shared catalog and change merge input
recommendation: deep-freeze descriptors or export deep copies

title: Manifest re-read + re-parse per call (no cache)
impact: whole-file read on once-per-turn hot path
recommendation: add TtlCache only if profiling shows need

title: capabilitiesGate.get returns descriptors without availability/authority filter
impact: production misuse could surface vapor capabilities; currently tests/diagnostics only
recommendation: annotate as diagnostics-only and add a guard test that production callers use visibleFor/expand

title: open_detail tool_id escape hatch missing from published JSON schema
impact: recovery path for descriptor-un-named deferred tools discoverable only via prompt prose; Tools domain owns fix
recommendation: add tool_id to schema + description in Tools domain

title: Manifest is workspace-scoped but tool resolution is not
recommendation: advertised set in ws A may include tools granted by global/other-scope rows; mirrors ToolExecutor exactly so no enforcement drift
column8: note; scope both sides together if resolver gains workspace param

title: expand() overwrites descriptor.tools with filtered schema names
impact: ExpandedCapability.tools no longer lists full descriptor tool set; consumers must read toolSchemas
recommendation: by design; document in Domain Spec

title: Manifest entry with non-array tools silently falls back to existing tools
impact: typo'd tools value keeps builtin tools with no warning
recommendation: warn when tools present but not an array (matches other warn-and-ignore paths)

title: Naming: domain types PascalCase vs AGENTS.md camelCase type rule
impact: new types must follow camelCase per AGENTS.md; existing frozen
recommendation: do not bulk-rename; apply rule to new types only
